title: Cross-Stream Correlation Leaderboard
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| stats avg(correlation_score) as avg_correlation_score max(correlation_score) as max_correlation_score by left_signal right_signal
| sort 0 - avg_correlation_score
description: Ranks signal pairss by cross-stream correlations.
value: A correlation leaderboard helps you see which signals actually move together instead of assuming connections by intuition.
implementation: Send cross-stream correlations events to `index=personal` and keep `left_signal` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of cross-stream correlations by signal pairs.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which signal pairss stand out most for cross-stream correlations.
